title: Tetris got the box instead.
description:
Tetris got the box instead. Nintendo of America's president saw no reason to pack in anything but his own plumber. A rival publisher talked him out of it.

That February he had flown to Moscow on a tourist visa and negotiated the handheld rights out of Elorg, the Soviet agency that owned Tetris. Then he went to see Arakawa about the box.

Mario is for little boys. 'If you want everyone to buy your Game Boy, pack in Tetris, young, old, male, female. And then you can still sell Mario afterwards.'

Copies of Game Boy Tetris shipped worldwide, most of them riding in the box with the console itself.

Mario still sold eighteen million. Afterwards.
